svg.text: Client persists flowState for next request (stateless architecture)
• processMessageStream() - Main agent entry point, async generator
• updateFlowStateFromMessage() - Updates state, parses intent, manages flow transitions
• determineToolChoice() - Decides which tools to allow based on flow step
• executeToolCall() - Validates and executes tools, updates state
• handleAssistantResponse() - Formats and streams final response
Processing: Intent → Flow State → Tool Choice → LLM → Tools → Response
Output: SSE Stream {content, done, context: {flowState}, options}
Stateless: flowState passed client ↔ server, no server-side storage
Iteration: Max 5 iterations, max 3 tool calls per request
